title: WP900 G8 must not treat condition-specific control absence as independent semantic observation
target: F2-WP-900 generation 8 independent reentry evidence binder

material_observation.positive_arm: GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt is recorder-origin and its REENTRY event is emitted only after observe_reentry validates concrete reentry provenance/binding. This is an actual positive observation candidate.
material_observation.control_arm: ControlNoBroadcastReadback.observe accepts caller-supplied reentry_observed and the ControlNoBroadcastReadback type itself rejects true. It has no symmetric recorder/event-window mechanism that independently observes the absence of reentry.
material_observation.g7_projection: MatchedTaskOutcomeReadback.observe_from_g4 still assigns reentry_observed directly from condition: INTERVENTION_BROADCAST -> true and CONTROL_NO_BROADCAST -> false.
material_observation.g8_claim_risk: If G8 merely validates the G4-bound GwtRuntimeWitnessReceipt and ControlNoBroadcastReadback hashes and derives REENTRY_OBSERVED from their contents, the positive arm is independently observed but the negative arm remains condition/type-constrained. Hash binding proves identity, not independent observation of absence.

falsifier_hypothesis: A G8 binder built only over the existing positive runtime witness and condition-specific ControlNoBroadcastReadback cannot close the non-circular semantic admission deficit, because the control-side absence is not measured by a condition-blind observation process. It can at most produce another exact-identity candidate with semantic-GWT/J-Space credit still zero.
counterhypothesis: The existing ControlNoBroadcastReadback is already sufficient because its target-runtime provenance plus exact source/boot/context binding makes the false value observationally trustworthy even without a symmetric recorder.

required_before_g8_repository_acceptance: Use one observation ABI for both arms whose outcome computation does not accept the arm condition or expected boolean as input.

For the no-broadcast arm, bind a closed observation window or equivalent trace evidence that can establish no matching reentry event occurred during the measured window; absence must not be inferred from the ControlNoBroadcastReadback type name or caller-provided false.

Prove a hard-negative swap: keeping arm labels fixed while swapping the underlying observation evidence must change or invalidate the semantic result. If the result remains tied to labels, fail closed.

Prove a forged-control negative: a caller cannot obtain a valid negative semantic observation merely by constructing/observing ControlNoBroadcastReadback with reentry_observed=false and arbitrary downstream hashes/provenance.
Bind exact source, boot, execution context, task identity, observer identity, observation-window identity and raw trace/evidence digest for both arms.

Keep repository, target-runtime, semantic-GWT, J-Space, effect, training, completion and whole-system promotion at zero until the exact G8 subject executes and the independent-observation invariant is reconciled.
discriminator.hard_negative: VALID_G4_HASH_BINDING + CONTROL_NO_BROADCAST_READBACK(false) does not by itself prove CONDITION_BLIND_ABSENCE_OBSERVED.

epistemic_boundary: Identity binding is not semantic observation.
Positive event observation is not symmetric evidence for negative-event absence.
A type that forbids true cannot serve as a condition-blind measurement of false without an external observation window/readback.
This packet grants no mutation authority and mints no credit.
next_exact_action: Active G8 owner should absorb this discriminator before repository acceptance: either add a symmetric condition-blind closed-window/trace observer for both arms, or explicitly demonstrate with executable evidence why ControlNoBroadcastReadback false is independently observed rather than condition/type asserted.
